name: Status
summary: Feedback about state: info, success, warning, error, empty or loading.

action.description: Optional Action (or ActionBar for a primary and a secondary) to recover or continue, e.g. 'Try again'; for 'undo', the Undo action

icon.description: Optional icon for empty states; the renderer picks one by kind otherwise

variant.description: 'inline' is a notice inside a page (a warning above a record) rather than a block of its own

whenToUse: Errors with a way to recover
'undo': after a reversible action ran, say what happened and offer Undo instead of asking first
whenNotToUse: Validation errors on a field: inputs show their own errors

requirements: success/info/loading are polite live regions; error is assertive
Meaning is in text, not only color or icon

agent: Reads the title and message; the recovery action is exposed.
rendering: error and warning use color.status.* tokens and an icon
empty states explain why and what to do next
loading shows a skeleton when layout is known, otherwise a progress indicator
'undo' renders as a snackbar at the bottom of the surface, announced politely, with the Undo action
Empty states may carry an ActionBar: one primary and one secondary action
'inline' renders a bordered notice with its action on the right

mappings.android: Snackbar / Card with status color / CircularProgressIndicator

sources: Nielsen: visibility of system status; help users recover from errors
